# Vendored export library

`pptxgenjs-4.0.1.bundle.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from the official npm package `pptxgenjs@4.0.1`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS
- Package SHA-1: `cd0f202f62f74d950bcd217e90b766da8f73742e`
- Downloaded from npm with lifecycle scripts disabled.
- PptxGenJS is MIT-licensed. See `PptxGenJS-LICENSE`.
- Its bundle includes JSZip and supporting code. Retain the embedded notices and the included third-party license files.

The app loads this local file only when PowerPoint export is requested. It uses no CDN or external export service.

To update it, pin a reviewed release, retain license notices, run the real OOXML export test, and review a rendered deck before publishing.
